This is an answer written by a candidate who achieved a Band 6.0 score. The given diagram describes the process of manufacturing bamboo fabrics. Overall, the process includes a few main stages, which are shown on the diagram and are numbered from 1 to 8.
The first stage, obviously, consists of planting and growing bamboo plants, usually happening in spring.

The second phase, We could say harvesting one, is happening in the middle part of the year in autumn. Bamboo stems are cutting off by the season workers, collecting and sending to the special plants during this period.
In the plants, what are showed a the third and the fourth stages. on the diagram, the bamboo stems are cutting into long strips, then produced strips are crushing to make liquid pulp.
During the next phase these pulp is filtering through the special types of sieves to separate long fibres from liquid.

Then the fibres, filtered by previous step, are being undergone through the softenning procedure. This procedure includes adding water and amine oxide. The seventh stage is the sppinning the soften fibres to make a strong bamboo thread.
Produced yarns might be used to make fabric, which is the last-eighth phase, by weaveing them using special equipment.
